record.original_question: How can the black hole information paradox be resolved so that black-hole formation and evaporation are reconciled with quantum-mechanical unitarity and information is not genuinely lost?

evidence.quote: Problem MPF1: Resolve the black hole information paradox.

artifact.status_search_result: The black hole information paradox remains an outstanding open problem in theoretical and mathematical physics. Recent work using the gravitational path integral and the "island formula" (Penington; Almheiri–Engelhardt–Marolf–Maxfield, 2019–2020) reproduces a unitary Page curve in certain models, providing significant progress, but a full, generally accepted resolution applicable to realistic evaporating black holes — including a complete account of the mechanism of information transfer — is not established.

status_evidence.title: Replica wormholes and the black hole interior
status_evidence.snippet: We compute the Page curve...replica wormholes give a unitary answer.
status_evidence.claim: Recent progress reproduces unitary Page curve, but the full paradox is not considered resolved.

status_evidence.title: Entanglement Wedge Reconstruction and the Information Paradox
status_evidence.snippet: Island formula provides Page curve consistent with unitarity.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress; underlying mechanism and general resolution still debated.
